warnings: Axes: x = 1..19 at 18 x 4.00 (72.00); y = A-B-C-D at 3.30 + 4.70 + 2.50 (10.50). Origin A1. Scanned สพฐ. standard set (S-01..S-12), every value read off zoomed crops.
The set is titled 'แบบที่ 1' office building; the column table (S-06) and the beam plans run footing -> floor 1 -> floor 2 -> floor 3 -> roof, i.e. 3 storeys, although the house slot is named 2ชั้น.
B (3.30) is printed only on S-01 (3.30 + 4.70) and as a local 3.30 at the stair bays on S-03/S-04; on S-02..S-04 the B bubble is drawn but not on the main chain (A-C 8.00).
B''' (lower stair-bay beam) is the only plan line with no printed dimension: measured by proportion, 6.30 (confidence 0.6).
Porch frame edges 3'/5'/14'/16' and D'''' are derived from the printed 0.80 chains (which are measured from the C5 column face) plus half the C5 width 0.35 — confidence 0.6.
B' (5.25, roof ridge) and B'' (5.30, beam line) are 0.05 apart — kept both: different things printed on different sheets.

Roof (S-05) prints 2.20 before grid 1 but 1.50 after grid 19 although the outline is drawn symmetric: the right-hand roof edge is therefore not a line (no printed dimension to it); 19' is the printed 1.50 tick.

Dimension sweep covers S-01..S-05 only. S-06..S-12 (column table, beam/stair/truss details) print member-internal dimensions that stay on their elements; architectural sheets A-01..A-13 (incl. building sections with the levels) were not swept in this op04 run, so z_levels holds only the footing datum label.
